I received fertilizer coupons through the FISP program this year, so I will apply some NPK and urea on this plot, though I will put most of what I have on my larger maize field. This plot is intercropped with groundnuts and soybeans, and I have managed to get improved seed for the legumes from the extension worker, but I cannot afford pesticides and there is no water for irrigation here. My household will provide all the labor for planting, weeding, and harvesting because the plot is small and we need to save money.
